notes: Some names state a specific behaviour that the body checks byte for byte, for example test_set_keeps_everything_else, test_folded_new_paragraph_uses_longest_line and test_set_through_scalar_is_5. Many others only name a topic with no condition or expected result (test_show_scalars, test_includes, test_flow_collections, test_usage_errors, test_history, test_crlf_file), and test_include_refused says less than its body, which also checks that nested sets write through to the included file, so from the name alone a triager could not tell what broke.
